scenario: A `call` with `on`, `timeout`, and `error` continuations compiles cleanly per LHYD.1.1. Call actions with full continuation clauses are accepted by the parser and compiler without error.
rules_ds:
schema HaReadReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    state: Int

service ha.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    response HaReadReply

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call ha.read entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 1_min
        on response.state > 0:
            log info "ok"
        timeout 30_s:
            log warning "timeout"
        error:
            log error "failed"
